ambiguous: Router emits only exact unique alias routes; a normalized alias mapping to different target lists invalidates the profile. No runtime entity ambiguity can be introduced.
authority: TargetPlan/source binding only; separate supplemental groups
budgets: No truncation. Target item/content overflow -> unavailable with empty items; whole-frame/projection overflow -> reject before answer call.
conflict: At least two valid candidates for the same target have different canonical content bytes, irrespective of rank or source priority.
dedup: Equal source_id/source_revision/item_id/target_key and equal canonical content only.
grounded: Complete required coverage and one or more agreeing candidates.
none: All required bindings complete and zero usable candidates; never inferred from failed or truncated retrieval.
ordering: Each item key compared as UTF-8 bytes ascending; opaque revisions never imply freshness.
required_coverage: Every required binding has exactly one complete ok or none outcome covering exactly its bound snapshots; no subset exception.
unavailable: Any missing/incomplete/failed required binding, or evidence/frame/projection budget overflow. Optional failures cannot satisfy required coverage.
validation: Reject profile/qid/scope/target/provider/source/revision mismatch, duplicate outcomes, invalid content digest or identity collisions before merge.
validity: Only static records without timestamps; reject as_of and timestamp-bearing evidence.
